title: SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. translated_title: SARATHI：面向结构化大语言模型剪枝的解耦式无数据探测与自适应重建
translated_abstract: 结构化剪枝通过永久移除神经元和权重行来降低大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本，从而实现与硬件无关的稠密加速。现有的训练后方法通过共享的校准数据集将神经元选择和权重重建耦合在一起，这不仅引入了领域偏差，还会在高稀疏度下导致内存溢出故障。我们提出了SARATHI，一个将这两个阶段解耦的框架。首先，无数据的NMF残差子空间探测（NMF Residual Subspace Probe）利用权重自身的内在几何结构对神经元进行评分，无需访问任何校准数据，并与鲁棒主成分分析存在形式化的理论联系。随后，自适应OBS方法使用局部化的校准批次来重建被剪枝的权重，每层的峰值内存开销仅为O(d²)，消除了耦合方法的全局内存瓶颈。此外，偏置偏移补偿步骤可以修正LayerNorm后置架构中原本会导致问题的系统性激活漂移。（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SARATHI将LLM结构化剪枝中的神经元探测（基于权重几何的无数据NMF残差子空间探测）与权重重建（采用局部校准的自适应OBS）解耦为两个独立阶段，从而消除了现有方法中的领域偏差和高稀疏度下的内存瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: SARATHI decouples structured LLM pruning into data-free neuron probing via NMF residual subspace analysis of weight geometry and adaptive weight reconstruction with localized calibration, eliminating domain bias and memory bottlenecks of coupled post-training methods.
